strategy_a_random_80_20.description: Standard independent 80/20 random split (45,984 train / 11,496 test).
strategy_a_random_80_20.justification: Ensures full representation of rare regional and vehicle model combinations across India while preventing temporal leakage.

strategy_b_price_stratified.justification: Guarantees identical representation of ultra-luxury exotics (Bugatti, Lamborghini) in both train and test.

strategy_c_temporal_audit.finding: The raw dataset provides manufacturing_year (1989-2025) but lacks listing timestamp / scraped date.
strategy_c_temporal_audit.verdict: Manufacturing year is a fundamental depreciation feature, NOT a valid time-series index. Manufacturing temporal splits would artificially prevent the model from learning older car valuations.

selected_production_strategy: Strategy A (Random 80/20 Split with Seed 42) + Decile Cross-Validation verification. This directly preserves compatibility with legacy benchmark baseline for transparent comparison.
